The '''Lead Rod''' is a [[Weapons#Club|club weapon]] that can be obtained by [[The Mines#Crates and Barrels|breaking boxes and barrels]], or as a [[The Mines#Special Items|special monster drop]], on levels 40-120 in [[The Mines]] and on levels 1-39 in the [[Skull Cavern]].
